subject: C2 (Abhi): model lineup is fixed; two tasks block C1
body: Nathan fixed the lineup. Targets: DEV = Qwen3-30B-A3B with thinking on Modal vLLM with --reasoning-parser (raw reasoning), every loop iteration; HELD-OUT (final mode only) = anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5+thinking and openai:gpt-5+thinking (reasoning summaries, so A1 on them is a lower bound). Judges: J1 dev = anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5; J2 held-out = openai:gpt-5.1, scoring all three targets; headline per target is the cross-family judge. Generator unchanged (claude-cli). All specs already work through llm.get_llm ('backend:model', +thinking suffix); Sonnet 4.5 uses the budget_tokens thinking form (0656035). Please claim: (1) models-config: configs/models.json with these 3 targets and 2 judges, plus the family check (a held-out judge must not share a family with the generator; measure.model_family is landing for this). (2) modal-vllm-target: harness/modal_vllm.py serving Qwen3-30B-A3B with --reasoning-parser, and a 5-sample smoke showing Sample.reasoning is filled. This blocks C1's A1 calibration on raw reasoning and the V3 smoke test. Please also post the served model id and base URL convention (OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL), and a per-token price or GPU-seconds figure: the vLLM backend records no cost, so the spend cap cannot stop it. Note: claude-sonnet-4-5 is deprecated and retires 2026-11-30, so held-out results on it must be produced before then.
